name: Etrean Guardmaster
speaker: entity:etrean_guardmaster
lines: Go save our people... They're most likely in the cells at the bottom of the fort...
Great work! Here, take one of these chests.
I'm afraid we can only fit so many on this boat... You'll have to come back later, please keep them safe until then. [x] minutes remain.
That would help us a lot... hold it out for me, let me take a look at this.
...I see. We have a lot of work ahead of us. Thank you, friend. Please, take this as a reward.
Huh? Hold out the note for me, let me see it. You said a Shipping Schedule.
You did a good job making it out of there in one piece. Let me fix those cuffs for you.
